notes.subject: nka
notes.rationale: Bamanankan bɛ tugu-daɲɛ wajibiya kumasen fila in cɛ; Heburukan ma min fɔ

notes.subject: a
notes.rationale: Nɔnabila farala ɲɛda (ופני) nɔ na — Heburukan ka daɲɛ in bɛ tɔgɔ tigi ta a yɛrɛ ma

notes.subject: san fila donw
notes.rationale: Kɔrɔyɔrɔ jate: Awshalom ka waati Yerushalayim kɔnɔ — שנתים ימים 'san fila donw' ka jɔcogo to a la

notes.subject: שנתים ימים
notes.rationale: Heburu ka 'sana donw' cogo bilenma (idiom kelen 'san fila') Bamanankan na a to a cogo bilenma la 'san fila donw'

translation: Awshalom ye Yerushalayim (Jerusalɛmu) kɔnɔ sigi san fila donw, nka masakɛ ka ɲɛ, a ma ⟨a⟩ ye.
